notes.text: This chain sits outside the ten-theme campaign slate (Ron's task, 2026-09-13): a DEPTH-style census, money-corner and UNDISCOVERED links first (green-methanol-production and methanol-dual-fuel-engines, both closing EXHAUSTED at one genuinely-thin public issuer each), then the remaining CHOKE_POINT link (methanol-ready-shipyard-capacity), then other links as far as the evidence bar held.

This run's WebSearch tool quota (200/200 calls) was already exhausted when research began, discovered on the first query of this session. Every subsequent lead was found through WebFetch alone: SEC EDGAR (reliable, static HTML), live.deutsche-boerse.com (reliable for German/Xetra names), a company's own annual report PDF when its exact download URL could be found by walking the company's own site (worked for Yangzijiang Shipbuilding, but even a fully-fetched 178-page annual report did not yield one excerpt carrying legal name, exchange and ticker together), and reuse of already-VERIFIED issuer/listing identity records from data/mappings/hormuz-maritime.json for issuers this run re-confirmed apply here (World Kinect, PetroChina, COSCO SHIPPING Holdings, Vopak; same issuer_id and identity_evidence, fresh methanol-specific role evidence). Most Hong Kong, Singapore, Korean and Shenzhen exchange sites returned unrendered JavaScript shells or 403/404 to WebFetch and could not be used. This is a statement about this run's reach, not the world's: the six links left fully OPEN at zero, and the partial counts on the other four OPEN links, plainly undercount real public issuers that a session with a live WebSearch budget or better exchange-site access would find.

Celanese Corporation (CE) was investigated as a conventional-methanol-production candidate and explicitly rejected on its own FY2025 10-K text: methanol is named there as a purchased raw material Celanese consumes to manufacture formaldehyde in-house, not something it produces. China Petroleum & Chemical Corp's own 20-F (filed 2023, its most recent on EDGAR) states its NYSE ADS program was terminated 5 December 2022, so its former NYSE ticker SNP is not usable as a current US listing; its H-share (0386.HK) and A-share (600028.SS) identity could not be fetched this run given the exchange-site access constraint above.
